nativeNavigation.timingBoundary: actual user action -> visible completion + actual IPC completion + animation frame
nativeNavigation.startup: NOT_MEASURED; no navigation/reload substituted for process launch
nativeNavigation.resume: NOT_MEASURED; requires separate actual process relaunch measurement
limitations: Encoded transport bytes are not decoded DTO size
Repeated semantic calls require intent/retry review

developmentReview.interpretation: Mount-time doubled reads are intentional StrictMode development probes, not production duplicate proof; do not compare timings to production bundle

limitations: Static counts are NOT measured query/render counts
OS cold cache cannot be controlled safely
CDP wire bytes are not decoded DTO bytes
No heap-leak absence claim without lifetime evidence

Navigation baseline covers five required critical path domains plus subpaths, NOT all eight; startup, actual resume, true project-open, Create submission, SQL/render counters and large dataset remain pending
